settings.divergence_comparison: paired by seed; 0.40 minus 0.25; seed streams remain the unchanged v2 streams
settings.estimand: mean of within-seed differences in normalized local net gain at each divergence
settings.missing_data_policy: require all 900 validated alignments, 900 scores and 600 comparisons before statistical estimates; do not silently exclude failed blocks
settings.multiplicity: marginal intervals; no simultaneous coverage or multiplicity-adjusted significance claim
settings.resampling: jointly resample 50 seed IDs with replacement; preserve all conditions and divergence levels per seed
